# repoquill

Documentation for repoquill

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/RepoQuill

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/RepoQuill/guides/quickstart/): Scaffold your repository and generate your first documentation site in under five minutes.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/RepoQuill/guides/installation/): Install RepoQuill via uvx, uv tool, or pip and configure your environment.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/RepoQuill/guides/architecture/): Understand the two-layer generation system: deterministic API reference vs. LLM-driven narrative guides.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/RepoQuill/guides/key-ideas/): Core concepts including incremental regeneration, source grounding, and AI-agent compatibility.
